newsitem.title: USA: IBS Financial loses round in court fight.
newsitem.headline: IBS Financial loses round in court fight.

text.p: IBS Financial Corp said on Tuesday it had lost a round in its legal fight with a group trying to gain a seat on its board.

IBS had filed a suit accusing the group, which includes Seidman and Associates L.L.C., of failing to disclose all required information when nominating a new IBS board member. But a judge ruled that IBS had rectified the matter by amending its nomination filing.

The court also said IBS could not reject the group's nomination based on the deficient initial filing, and that IBS must provide the group with a shareholder list. The court also set aside IBS's reduction of its board from seven directors to six.
IBS said it was reviewing the court's decision and considering its legal options.
IBS Financial is a holding company which owns Inter-Boro Savings and Loan Association. The group that includes Seidman has a stake in IBS.
